messages:
Zoe (Docs): opened PR to refresh the Argent4b model card + catalog row. Changes: add supported-hardware matrix, clarify long-context streaming behavior (up to 16k with KV cache and caveats), update quant compatibility section to runtime labels, and replace old SDK snippets with streaming examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5109 please quick-review for any ops/legal language.

Hector (Runtime): quick note 1 use runtime labels in the compat table (argent4b-q4_k_m, argent4b-q8_0, argent4b-fp16). Also mention our automatic fp16 fallback when q4 kernels are missing on a host. Otherwise support will get a spike of 500s.

Priyanka (Bench): added bench runs in PR comments: argent4b-q4_k_m on A10: 165-205 tok/s (batch=1, seq=4k); on T4: 60-85 tok/s (batch=1, seq=4k). High variance with cold starts and prompt shape. I'll attach the harness + exact docker tag for reproducibility. Recommend publishing ranges and the exact run command.

Dmitri (DevEx): swapped in streaming snippets and added a small fallback-detection example. Python snippet in PR:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.generate_stream('Summarize the report', model='argent4b-q4_k_m'):
    if chunk.meta.get('runtime_fallback'):
        print('\\n[fallback to ' + chunk.meta.get('runtime_variant') + ']')
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
JS parity pushed as well. Can runtime confirm the meta keys?

Hector (Runtime): meta keys are runtime_fallback (bool) and runtime_variant (string). good to include an explicit pin example for Dedicated customers: e.g., use "model: 'argent4b-fp16'" in configs to avoid auto-fallbacks.

Noah (PM): please avoid marketing absolutes in the public blurb. For throughput callout use a qualified sentence: "expected throughput: ~60-85 tok/s on T4 and ~165-205 tok/s on A10 (batch=1, seq=4k); measured with our canonical benchmark prompts." Add a one-line rollback/canary note for Dedicated customers who pin variants.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check failed  markdown-lint: duplicate-anchor-id in supported-hardware table. See https://ci.redwood.dev/1422

Zoe (Docs): fixing anchors and swapping internal runtime link to public runtime-mapping page. Also added Noah's phrasing and the Dedicated pin note. Re-requesting review.

Priyanka (Bench): added small note about batching: "batching increases amortized throughput but raises p95 latency; see batching guidance." Attached bench script as hidden PR artifact.

Dmitri (DevEx): confirmed JS example added and included a small comment showing the stream emits a metadata event before the first fallback chunk. Pushed.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check passed on second run :white_check_mark: 

Noah (PM): LGTM from PM side. Zoe please include a 1-line migration note for customers who referenced the legacy name "argent4b" without variant suffix.

Zoe (Docs): will merge in ~10m unless any objections. I'll post a short summary in #docs-release after merge calling out catalog change, fallback behavior, and bench caveats. Thanks all! :rocket:
